label: Listening 1 — What's in your bag?
lines: Listening one. What's in their bags? Circle the right answer.
I'm Sara. In my bag I've got three pens and a notebook.
I'm Ben. My bag is really heavy, because there's a big dictionary in it!
Hi, I'm Lucy. I've got two notebooks, one for English and one for maths.
I'm Tom. It's raining today, so I've got an umbrella in my bag.
I'm Mia. Look, this is my new pencil case!

label: Listening 2 — Lost and found
lines: Listening two. Lost and found. Listen and complete.
OK, everyone. Whose is this black bag? Jack, is it yours?
Oh, that's my pen. I'm Emma.
Leo, are these your books on my desk?
And that umbrella by the door? That's my umbrella.
Excuse me, where's my pencil case?
Look, Mia. It's under your chair.

label: Listening 3 — What do they do?
lines: Listening three. What do they do? Circle the right answer.
My dad is a doctor. He works in a big hospital.
I'm a teacher. I teach English at a school in London.
My uncle is a farmer. He's got lots of cows and sheep.
My mum is a pilot. She flies to Japan and the USA.
I'm a cook. I work in a small restaurant in Paris.
